meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 作为omo新手指南，带新用户依次走完功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值估算、记忆记录、init-deep建议六步。用用户的语言说话，拒绝的可选环节就跳过，学到的事实实时写入记忆。
howto.when: 当新用户提出要开始使用omo时触发；首次安装后自动启动一次；也可用`senpi --onboard`重新唤起。

say.note: 启动完整的六步引导流程。

say.text: 我是新用户，帮我完成 omo 设置。
say.note: Claude会从功能导览开始引导你。

say.text: 我原来用 Claude Code，想把配置迁过来。
say.note: 进入迁移帮助环节，Claude会先查看旧配置。

howto.what_en: Turns the agent into a guide for first-time omo users: walks them through the six-step core workflow in their own language, skips declined elective lanes, and records durable personal facts into memory as it goes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new user asks to get started with omo; also auto-starts once on first install; can be relaunched via `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo.
I'm new here—help me set up omo.
I'm coming from Claude Code; can you migrate my setup?
